raw_segments.text: In long lassos from the cock, like the water, flowed full,
Covering green-goldenly lagoons of sand, rising, flowing.
My ash-plint will float away, I shall wait.
Now they will pass on, passing, chafing against the low rocks, swirling, passing.
Better get this job over quick.
Listen, a forwarded wave-speech, Sisu HRSS R.S.S.S.
Ooze, vehement breath of waters amid sea-snakes, rearing horses rocks.
In cups of rocks it slops, flop, slop, slap, bounded in barrels,
It flows purling, widely flowing, floating foam-pool, flower unfurling.
